offence: Breach of Article 12.2.1 i) of the International Sporting Code and non-compliance with Race Director's Event Note (item 10, document 59) - Practice start infringement.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video and in-car video evidence and determined that Car 27 was out of position when conducting a practice start compared with where the Race Director's Event Note required such starts to be made. Reconnaissance laps are treated as laps within a practice session (as opposed to the Race). No other cars were affected nor was this done in a dangerous manner. We therefore administer a warning.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 27 Practice Start
to: The Team Manager, Kick Sauber F1 Team
